Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Specialist Solutions Architects (SSA) are domain experts aligned to specific Stripe solutions and customer buying centers. We have in-depth knowledge of specific solution offerings and a deep understanding of customer challenges.

We align with specialist product sellers on deals, advise the broader pre-sales team on complex opportunities, support pipeline development and revenue attainment, serve as an advisor on go-to-market sales plays, and provide critical insights to our product and engineering teams.

You will collaborate closely with sales and pre-sales teams to drive pipeline and revenue targets, while also educating the product and engineering teams on market trends and strongly influencing the product roadmap.

You will develop deep relationships with senior customer business leaders and grow Stripe's solution offerings with new and existing customers. As a subject matter expert, you will scale the broader organization by creating reusable assets and coaching others on complex, high-value opportunities.
The team is looking for a Revenue and Finance Automation specialist with a deep understanding of the order-to-cash process and how modern businesses manage subscription billing, invoicing, and revenue recognition. You will engage with customers as a thought leader in the billing infrastructure space, helping them design solutions on Stripe Billing that reduce churn, improve cash collection, and align their financial operations with accurate revenue recognition under GAAP/IFRS standards.

Act as a subject matter expert on Stripe's Billing, Invoicing, and Revenue Recognition products to accelerate opportunities
Demonstrate a deep understanding of the order-to-cash process—including subscription and usage-based billing, dunning, proration, and revenue recognition workflows—and how these map to Stripe's platform
Conduct deep discovery of customers' existing billing architecture and business model to architect solutions that align Stripe's capabilities with their quote-to-cash requirements
Advise customers on how to design for complexity: mid-cycle upgrades, entitlement management, multi-currency revenue recognition, and integration with ERP systems (NetSuite, Workday, SAP)
Create and share best practices and reusable assets such as reference architectures to enhance the quality and efficiency of the broader sales and pre-sales organizations
Partner closely with the Billing product sales team and actively drive opportunities for Stripe's largest customers, leading solution strategy and owning key customer relationships
Serve as a "Voice of the Customer" to drive product and feature request prioritization
Identify product, industry, implementation, and competitive trends, and provide actionable insights to product stakeholders and sales to influence Stripe's billing product roadmap
Act as an escalation point to drive complex technical issues to resolution with Stripe's engineering team
Represent the technical health of the business on quarterly sales forecast calls and highlight deal blockers with proposed solutions
Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

7+ years of experience in a technical sales, pre-sales, or solutions architecture role, with a focus on billing, subscription, or revenue management platforms
3+ years of hands-on experience with the order-to-cash process in a SaaS environment, including subscription lifecycle management, dunning, and revenue recognition
Strong understanding of revenue recognition standards (ASC 606, IFRS 15) and how they apply to SaaS and usage-based business models
Experience working with or implementing billing and ERP software (NetSuite, Workday, SAP, Zuora, BillingPlatform, or similar)
Strong knowledge of software engineering and API integration patterns
Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, comfortable explaining complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners
Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment

Experience integrating Stripe or other RESTful APIs into web applications
Familiarity with complex billing scenarios: usage-based pricing, tiered models, multi-entity revenue recognition, or hybrid subscription and consumption models
Experience with CRM platforms and their integration with billing systems
Experience as a subject matter expert in a relevant industry, vertical, or product

Recruiter: Dina Hussain
Location: London, UK
Industry: Manufacturing, Defence and Automotive
At Databricks, our core values are at the heart of everything we do. A culture of proactiveness and a customer-centric mindset guides us in creating a unified platform that makes data science and analytics accessible to everyone. We aim to inspire our customers to make informed decisions that push their business forward.

We provide a user-friendly and intuitive platform that makes it easy to turn insights into action and fosters a culture of creativity, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
You will be a vital part of this mission, utilising your technical expertise to demonstrate how our Lakehouse Platform can help customers address their complex data challenges. You'll work with a collaborative, customer-focused team who values innovation and creativity, using your skills to create customised solutions to help our customers achieve their goals and guide their businesses forward. Join us in our quest to change how people work with data and make a better world!
Reporting to the Manager, Field Engineering.

Form successful relationships with clients throughout your assigned territory, providing technical and business value to Databricks customers in collaboration with Account Executives.
Operate as an expert in big data analytics to excite customers about Databricks. You will develop into a ‘champion’ and trusted advisor on multiple issues of architecture, design, and implementation to lead to the successful adoption of the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.
Author reference architectures, how-tos, and demo applications to scale best practices in your field and support customers. Lead workshops, seminars, and meet-ups to help build the Databricks community in your region and scale best practices in your field.
Grow your knowledge and expertise to the level of a technical and/or industry specialist.

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically skilled individual to join our UK&I Enterprise Manufacturing, Defence and Automotive which focuses on supporting and growing customers in the UK&I. This role offers the opportunity to be based in the London Office, with regular collaboration across the UK&I region and close alignment with our London-based team.

Hands-on experience in technical pre-sales or consultancy, with a strong background in Data Science - traditional Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Artificial Intelligence or Generative AI.
Demonstrated ability to architect end-to-end Data & AI solutions, with specific expertise in modern Generative AI concepts (e.g., fine-tuning, RAG, MLOps for LLMs), using either open source and/or ISV tools such as Dataiku, Domino, DataRobot etc.
Strong proficiency in a core programming language (e.g., Python, SQL) and a willingness to learn (or existing knowledge of) Spark.
Proficiency with big data analytics technologies and public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Hands-on expertise in designing and delivering complex proofs-of-concept (PoCs).

Proven ability to engage with customers in a technical sales capacity: challenging assumptions, guiding discussions to clear outcomes, and communicating both technical and business value propositions.
Experience in the full pre-sales lifecycle, including use case discovery, solution scoping, and delivering complex solution architecture designs to diverse audiences (from engineers to executives).
A customer-centric mindset with a passion for building client relationships and internal partnerships with account teams.
Demonstrated experience in coaching and mentoring junior team members to help them develop their technical and customer-facing skills.

Ability to commute to the London office regularly.
Willingness and ability to travel approximately 20-30% of the time across UK&I and EMEA for customer visits.

Databricks or other relevant Cloud/Data certifications.
Experience working within the Manufacturing, Defence or Automotive sectors.

As a Specialist Solutions Architect (SSA) - Data Engineering and Warehousing, you will guide customers through cloud data engineering transformations across a wide variety of use cases.
In this customer-facing role, you will collaborate with and support Solutions Architects. This requires hands-on production experience with large-scale data engineering technologies and lakehouse architecture. The SSA teams help customers navigate evaluations and successfully plan production for their business intelligence workloads while aligning their technical roadmap with the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.
As a deep go-to expert reporting to the Specialist Field Engineering Manager, you will continue to strengthen your technical skills through mentorship, continuous learning, and internal training programs. In this role, you will establish yourself as a leader in the data engineering and warehousing specialty.

Provide technical leadership to guide strategic customers to successful implementations on big data projects and large-scale data warehousing workloads.
Prove the value of the Databricks Intelligence Platform for customer workloads by architecting production workloads, including end-to-end pipeline load performance testing and optimization.
Architect production-level data pipelines, including end-to-end pipeline load performance testing and optimization.
Become a technical expert in an area such as data lake technology, big data streaming, or big data ingestion and workflows.
Assist Solution Architects with more advanced aspects of the technical sale, including custom proof of concept content, estimating workload sizing, and custom architectures.
Provide tutorials and training to improve community adoption (including hackathons and conference presentations).
Contribute to the Databricks Community.

8+ years of experience in a technical role with deep expertise across the following areas:
Software / Data Engineering: Hands-on experience with data ingestion, streaming technologies (e.g., Spark Streaming, Kafka), performance tuning, troubleshooting, and debugging Spark or other big data solutions.
Data Applications Engineering: Experience building data-driven use cases, such as risk modeling, fraud detection, and customer lifetime value (LTV).
Data Warehousing: Advanced query tuning, troubleshooting, data governance, and debugging MPP data warehouses or big data solutions. Experience migrating workloads from EDW systems (e.g., traditional SQL, Redshift, Snowflake, Synapse, EMR) across OLAP & OLTP workloads.
Data Observability: Experience with SIEM tools (e.g., Splunk, Elastic, Sentinel), telemetry/high-velocity log ingestion, and anomaly detection.
Proven track record of maintaining, scaling, and extending production data systems to evolve with complex business needs.
Deep expertise across multiple core data engineering domains, including:
Designing and scaling cost-efficient, high-performance data workloads (ETL/ELT, analytics) in cloud environments.
Building and migrating large-scale data pipelines, including batch, CDC (Change Data Capture), and streaming ingestion.
Migrating on-premises or Hadoop-based data systems to modern cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Developing and managing modern lakehouse and warehouse systems, including Delta Lake technologies, data modeling, governance, and BI integration.
Production programming experience in SQL and at least one of the following: Python, Scala, or Java.
Strong familiarity with cloud infrastructure providers (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is highly desirable.
Degree or Equivalent: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
3+ years of customer-facing experience in a pre-sales or post-sales technical role.
Ability to meet expectations for technical training and role-specific milestones within 6 months of hire.
Willingness to travel up to 30% as needed.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies.

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request.

As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools.

Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up.

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations: Sydney, Australia

As a Principal Solutions Architect, you'll be a trusted advisor to Cloudflare's most strategic enterprise customers across the Asia Pacific region. You will work at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and executive influence, helping organisations in industries such as financial services, government, and telecommunications navigate complex digital transformation journeys using Cloudflare's platform.
You'll speak the "customer language", understand the CxO mindset, and influence technology decisions at the intersection of risk, resilience, and innovation.

Whether it's advising a CISO on a Zero Trust security strategy, helping a CIO rationalise their network architecture, or working with engineering leadership on edge-native application modernisation, you'll help our most important customers reimagine how the Internet works for them and position Cloudflare as the foundational platform for that future.
You'll be embedded in account planning with our sales and solutions engineering teams, operating proactively across the full customer lifecycle; from early strategic discovery through to long-term platform adoption and expansion. As a Principal Solutions Architect, you'll also play a significant role in raising the architectural capability of the broader Solutions Engineering organisation across APAC.

Own long-term executive relationships across Cloudflare's most strategic APAC accounts; engaging CIOs, CTOs, and CISOs on their multi-year technology agendas and positioning Cloudflare as a foundational platform, not a point solution.
Design and facilitate executive vision-setting and architecture workshops that produce tangible outcomes: multi-year roadmaps, reference architectures, and business cases co-developed with customers' enterprise architects and engineering leadership.
Translate industry trends like Zero Trust, Digital Sovereignty, AI workload security, cloud-to-edge migration into actionable architectural strategies tailored to each customer's business context and regulatory environment.
Guide clients across the full engagement lifecycle; from strategic discovery and architecture design through proof of concept, value realisation, and expansion planning while proactively partnering with the Sales and Solutions Engineering team to surface architectural opportunities before deals are formally scoped.
Elevate the architectural capability of the broader APAC Solutions Engineering team by developing reusable workshop frameworks, reference architectures, and best practices that others can apply independently; and by mentoring Solutions Engineers in senior stakeholder engagement.
Represent Cloudflare externally at industry events, executive roundtables, and sector forums as a credible peer to enterprise architects and technology leaders; produce content: white papers, architectural guidance that establishes Cloudflare's voice on key transformation themes across the region.
What Success Looks Like

You've established trusted advisor relationships with senior technical and business stakeholders across 3-5 of Cloudflare's most strategic APAC accounts.
You've designed and facilitated 2-3 executive vision-setting or architecture workshops that have resulted in documented multi-year roadmap alignment with Cloudflare embedded as a core platform component.
You've shaped at least one strategic engagement where you've connected Cloudflare's developer and edge compute capabilities to a customer's application modernisation or AI strategy; demonstrating platform breadth beyond security alone.
You've contributed at least one reusable asset to the APAC SE team; a workshop framework, reference architecture, or architectural playbook that others can apply independently.

15+ years of experience in technical presales, enterprise architecture, or IT leadership (e.g., Chief Architect, CTO, CISO).
A genuine ability to operate at two levels simultaneously: credible in a boardroom conversation about digital strategy, and capable of going deep on architecture design with engineering teams.
Demonstrated experience leading executive-level workshops, technology strategy sessions, or architectural visioning engagements with tangible business outcomes.
Strong understanding of transformation priorities relevant to APAC enterprises: Zero Trust architecture, cloud and network modernisation, digital sovereignty and data residency, AI infrastructure, and application performance at scale.
Experience with modern application architecture patterns (microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, CI/CD, serverless and edge compute).
A track record of proactively contributing to pipeline and account expansion through architectural influence — not just responding to requests.
Proven ability to enable and elevate peers: you've built frameworks, run internal enablement, or mentored others at scale.
Confident, compelling communicator in both executive business settings and technical deep dives and comfortable representing Cloudflare publicly at industry events.
Bonus: Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF), security standards (NIST SP 800-207, ISO 27001), and IT risk management principles relevant to regulated industries.

Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Security, or related field.
Experience in regulated industries (FSI, Government, Telco) or complex multi-cloud/hybrid environments.
Hands-on technical curiosity: you stay current across networking, cloud infrastructure, application security, and developer platforms; not because the job requires it, but because you find it genuinely interesting.

We are looking for a passionate technologist to join our Pre-Sales organization and help ensure our growth is grounded in strong technical alignment between MongoDB, our partners, and the needs of our customers.
MongoDB Solutions Architects help customers and partners design and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. On the Partners team, this role goes beyond core solution design and includes driving technical strategy with hyperscalers, GSIs, ISVs, and ecosystem partners; shaping joint solutions; and creating repeatable field assets that accelerate adoption.
You will work closely with sales, partner, and technical stakeholders to solve business problems with MongoDB, influence complex opportunities, and help build partner-led growth in India and across the region.
This role will be based remotely in Bengaluru.

Design scalable, secure, and high-performing application, data, and AI architectures using MongoDB Atlas for customer and partner-led solutions
Act as a trusted technical advisor to partners, sellers, and customers by guiding architecture reviews, modernization strategies, and deployment decisions across cloud and hybrid environments
Work on complex partner and ecosystem opportunities that require deep technical discovery, solution mapping, demos, proofs of value, sizing, and technical documentation
Build and refine joint partner offerings, integration patterns, quick starts, workshops, demos and reference architectures with hyperscalers, ISVs, and strategic ecosystem partners
Create reusable field assets such as demos, presentations, sample architectures, workshops, and technical guidance that help sellers and partners scale MongoDB adoption.
Advise on modern AI application patterns including RAG, vector search, agentic workflows, and integration approaches across partner ecosystems
Support field and partner teams with implementation guidance, technical objections, and practical workarounds where product capabilities, frameworks, or documentation are still evolving
Collaborate with product, engineering, and partner teams to relay field feedback, influence roadmap conversations, and improve the quality of MongoDB integrations and partner experiences
Partner with account teams on territory and account planning, opportunity qualification, pipeline generation, and technical win strategy
Represent MongoDB externally through customer workshops, partner sessions, industry events, and thought leadership content
Mentor peers and help raise the bar for the broader Solutions Consulting organization through knowledge sharing and repeatable best practices
As an ideal candidate, you will have
12+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, including significant pre-sales, consulting, partner, or solutions architecture experience in enterprise software
Strong experience navigating complex sales cycles and aligning technical and business stakeholders across customers, partners, and internal teams
Hands-on experience with modern application development, data platforms, or cloud-native systems, including at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, JavaScript, Java, C#, or SQL
Experience designing distributed systems in cloud and hybrid environments with an understanding of scalability, resilience, and security considerations
The ability to translate technical architecture into business value for executives, architects, developers, and partner stakeholders
Experience working with one or more of the following: hyperscaler partnerships, ISV integrations, AI/ML applications, data engineering, platform modernization, or developer platforms
A demonstrated ability to create technical assets, lead workshops, and enable broader field teams with reusable content and repeatable patterns
Strong presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority
Familiarity with modern sales methodologies and strong collaboration with sales leadership
The ability to travel up to 25%
You may also have
Experience with database programming and data models
Experience in data engineering or AI/ML projects
Experience in transforming legacy systems and platforms into modern, scalable, and efficient technology stacks
Experience in SRE practices
Proven ability to up-level the broader organization - for example by sharing best practices or creating reusable assets
A MongoDB Certification or a Cloud Provider Certification
Experience with MongoDB Atlas and adjacent services such as Search, Vector Search, Stream Processing, Data Lake, and related application modernization patterns
Experience with partner technologies and ecosystems such as AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Apache Kafka, or framework-level integrations used in modern AI applications
A track record of public speaking, publishing technical content, or representing a company in external technical forums
What you will learn
MongoDB Product Suite Mastery
Core Database Server: Master the fundamentals and advanced features of MongoDB's core database
Atlas and Advanced Services: Gain expertise in Atlas (fully managed cloud database service), Atlas Stream Processing, Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, and Charts
Relational Migrator: Learn to migrate from relational databases seamlessly

Hyperscaler Ecosystem: Gain expertise in designing complex systems utilizing cloud services on hyperscaler platforms
Complementary Technologies: Enhance your skills with partner and complementary technologies such as Apache Kafka and Kubernetes

Design Patterns and Methodologies: Embrace best practices in microservices, DevOps, cloud, and security
Cutting Edge RAG and AI Architectures: Help customers on their generative AI journeys and working with industry leading partners in the space

Effective Communication: Master presentations, demonstrations, and whiteboarding
Client Interaction: Develop strategies for discovery and objection handling

Diverse Market Verticals: Gain exposure to a broad spectrum of interesting use cases across various industries
Why this role matters
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys blending solution architecture, partner strategy, technical sales, and emerging technology. The strongest candidates will be comfortable operating at the intersection of customer outcomes, partner ecosystems, field enablement, and product innovation.
About MongoDB
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software.

MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI.

Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

We are looking for passionate technologists to join our Pre-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.
MongoDB Pre-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to design and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform.

Our team is made up of seasoned technical sales professionals, software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations.

You'll work closely with our sales executives, helping customers solve business problems by leveraging our solutions, playing a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations.
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Singapore for our hybrid working model.

The Partner Solutions Architect (PSA) is the technical force multiplier of Elastic's partner ecosystem. Where an account Solutions Architect wins one deal at a time, you build the technical capacity of a focused portfolio of partners — system integrators, resellers, MSSPs and cloud providers — so they source pipeline, win deals and deliver Elastic without us in the room.
The role rests on three pillars: drive growth with and through partners (partner-sourced pipeline); act as an architect of leverage (every partner engineer you certify adds technical selling capacity Elastic didn't have to hire); and co-innovate on repeatable solutions (joint blueprints, demos and partner-built offerings on our technology — including vertical and managed solutions Elastic doesn't build itself).
This is a pre-sales role that carries a partner-sourced pipeline target. You will work a defined portfolio of managed partners, each with an agreed technical engagement plan, and be measured on outputs — partner sourced deals, committed engagement plans and published assets — not on activity volume.
What you will be doing
Drive growth with and through partners
Generate approved partner deal registrations, jointly owned with Partner Managers for your territory.
Run partner-tailored sales playbooks on registered deals: qualify the deal shape, support intake and technical scoping, and help partners attach their own services — lifting average deal size.
Accelerate partner-led opportunities, hands-on labs and proofs of concept, in collaboration with account AEs and SAs.
Architect of leverage
Own the technical relationships and named champions at each partner in your portfolio; build trusted advisor status with senior technical stakeholders.
Create, commit and maintain a Technical Engagement Plan per focus partner — the technical section of the Joint Business Plan — and run quarterly read-outs with the partner, Partner Manager and other stakeholders.
Deliver enablement and certification roadmaps — workshops, hands-on labs, accreditations, certifications — that move partners up a defined technical maturity model, from first knowledge to fully autonomous, market-leading practices.
Co-innovate on repeatable solutions
Co-architect solution blueprints and reference architectures with partners, including hyperscaler patterns on AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure.
Back partner-built solutions on Elastic — vertical, sovereign and managed offerings that extend our product surface beyond what Elastic builds itself.
Build reusable demos, sales cards and battlecards partners can run without Elastic in the room; co-publish reference win stories and joint blog posts. Everything lands in a central repository for reuse across the ecosystem.
How success is measured
We measure this role on four transparent objectives, reviewed quarterly with evidence: approved partner-sourced deal registrations against territory targets (the headline metric); execution of the partner sales playbooks that grow average deal size; committed and reviewed Technical Engagement Plans; and published repeatable assets. Pipeline and capacity, not activity.

Fluency in French, Spanish, and English (business level) is a mandatory requirement
Experience in at least one of those technologies/solutions is a must: enterprise search, observability, or cybersecurity
Experience with cybersecurity (SIEM, SOAR, XDR, Endpoint) is a strong advantage
5+ years in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting and/or cloud/infrastructure technologies.
5+ years of pre-sales experience in the software sector, ideally partner-facing: channel, alliances, SI/GSI or MSSP ecosystems.
A one-to-many mindset: you would rather teach ten engineers to run the demo than run it ten times yourself, and you can show where your enablement turned into someone else's win.
Working knowledge of security operations (SIEM, endpoint, cloud security) and/or observability — the solution areas where our partner business is growing fastest — plus an understanding of AI and semantic search technologies (RAG, vector search, NLP).
Professional experience architecting or operating solutions on AWS, Google Cloud or Microsoft Azure.
Commercial fluency: you can read a deal, talk services scope and margin with a partner, and translate technical capability into the business case their customer buys.
Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and non-technical audiences — a partner engineer in the morning, an architect in the afternoon, an executive sponsor in the evening.
Comfort with ambiguity and a self-starter's bias to action; you inspire partner teams to work on what is most relevant, not just what is urgent.
Ability to travel up to 30%.

Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Applied AI Architects, creating an environment of technical excellence, sound judgment, continuous learning, accountability, and strong customer stewardship.

Lead complex, multi-threaded customer journeys that connect executive vision and business outcomes with use-case qualification, solution evaluation, enterprise governance, and a credible path to production.
Coach the team on Applied AI architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, identity, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, reliability, and deployment.
Build trusted relationships with C-suite and board-level stakeholders, as well as senior AI, technology, data, security, and engineering leaders, serving as an executive technical sponsor when needed.
Mobilize Deployment Engineering, implementation, enablement, Product, Engineering, Research, Security, Legal, Privacy, partners, and other specialists to remove blockers and deliver a cohesive customer experience.

アイデンティティセキュリティ基盤「Josys」について
Josysは、企業内のあらゆる認証情報（アイデンティティ）を統合的に管理・防御する、AI駆動のアイデンティティセキュリティ基盤です。従業員・業務委託先のアカウントに加え、AIエージェントやサービスアカウントなど、人・AI・システムを横断して増加する認証情報を一元的に可視化し、守ります。
ダークウェブ起点の認証情報漏洩・感染端末の検知、AIエージェントの自動発見と管理、ポリシーにもとづくAIの自律型セキュリティ対応を中核に、SaaS統合管理で培ったアクセスガバナンスやライセンス最適化の機能を統合。権限管理やリスク対応を自動化し、セキュリティ人材不足のなかでも運用負荷を抑えながら、組織全体のアイデンティティを守ります。
Josysは、"すべてのアイデンティティ、すべてのアプリケーションを、AIで守る"ことを通じて、日本企業が安心して事業活動を行える環境づくりを推進してまいります。
解決する課題
急速に利用が拡大するSaaS・AIアプリにより、世界中のコーポレート部門は複雑な管理業務を求められる状況にあります。また、昨今のサイバーセキュリティインシデントでは、漏洩したIDを用いた攻撃がスタンダードとなっており、エンタープライズを中心により高いレベルでの対策が急務となっています。
一方で、求められる速度に管理が追いつかず、管理の抜け・更新漏れ・管理主体の分散など、企業のITガバナンスは危機的な状況にあります。これはコロナ禍を経てSaaS利用が増大した背景があり、日本だけでなくグローバルで同時多発的に発生している新しい課題であり、企業規模に関わらず多くの企業が抱えている経営リスクです。
そこで求められるのは、AIによってアイデンティティ・SaaS・デバイスの情報を統合的に管理し、リスクを最小化しながら運用を効率化することです。ジョーシスはAI Drivenなマネジメントプラットフォームを通じて、現場のオペレーションまで一貫して支援し、企業のアイデンティティ管理におけるガバナンス向上とセキュリティリスクの最小化に寄与します。
日本発グローバル企業への挑戦
海外発SaaSを国内で使う機会は多いものの、グローバルで使われる日本発SaaSはほとんどないのが実情です。それだけ "グローバルプロダクト" を事業として成功させることの難易度は高いとも言えます。JOSYSはそんな現状を打ち破り、日本をマザーマーケットとしながら世界でも使われるサービスを提供していくチャレンジの真っ只中にいます。この難易度の高い課題を、優秀なグローバルの同僚と共に、自分自身の手で創り上げていく熱い想いのある方を募集しています。
概要
エンタープライズ／大企業を主対象に、商談での技術プリセールス（ソリューションアーキテクト）から、スクリプト・自動化・API連携の実装、そして導入・オンボーディング〜Go Liveまでを技術で牽引する Solutions Architect（テクニカルプリセールス／オンボーディング）を募集します。
あなたは二つの顔を持ちます。ひとつは、商談における“技術の最終権威”。顧客のIT・セキュリティ責任者の鋭い質問に的確に答え、デモやPoCで価値を証明し、実現可能なアーキテクチャを描く役割です。もうひとつは、契約後に導入・オンボーディングを牽引する“実装エンジニア”。生成AIを活用したキッティングやアカウントプロビジョニングによる“人の作業の極小化”、顧客のビジネスルールに基づくプロセス自動化を、スクリプトとAIで自らの手で組み上げます。
役割の本質は、“作って終わり”ではなく“動くまで、価値が出るまで責任を持つ”こと。ソフトウェアエンジニアリング × プロダクト思考 × 顧客への深い理解が交わる、いま最も市場価値の高いエンジニア像を、日本のエンタープライズ×アイデンティティセキュリティ領域で体現するポジションです。

このポジションで得られる経験・キャリア
AIとAutonomousを前提とした最先端の実装現場に立つことで、この時代でしか得られない“希少な市場価値”が身につきます。
最先端AI／Autonomous領域の実装経験：デモではなく、実際のエンタープライズ環境でAI・自律型エージェントやポリシー自動実行を“動くソリューション”に落とし込む経験。いま最も価値の高いスキルセットです。
Applied AI／高付加価値エンジニアへの道：スクリプト・連携・自動化を自ら実装し、AIを実戦投入してGo Liveまで担う経験は、いま最も需要が高まっているApplied AI／自動化エンジニアやソリューションアーキテクトとしての市場価値に直結します。

その先に開ける複数のキャリア：Applied AI Engineer、Solutions Architect、プラットフォーム/インテグレーションエンジニア、プリセールス組織や技術チームのリーダーなど、多様な道へ分岐していきます。
このポジションの魅力
技術で事業転換の最前線に立てる：「すべてのアイデンティティをAIでガバナンスする」という大きなBetを、実装の最前線で担えます。

圧倒的な当事者性：作って終わりではなく、顧客の環境で“動く”まで責任を持つ。手触り感のある仕事です。

Identify opportunities to improve clients' use of Nymbus Connect and proactively surface recommendations before issues arise.

As Salesforce Architect, you will be the technical backbone of Marqeta's Business Systems team, a lean, high-impact group that serves as the internal Salesforce platform team for Go-To-Market (GTM), Product Support, and Legal, Risk & Compliance (LRC). This is a heavily hands-on lead individual contributor role, you will be writing code, configuring the platform, and directly solving hard technical and business problems, not just producing designs for others to build.
We are looking for someone who has genuinely operated as an architect, owning architecture decisions, tradeoffs, and their consequences for at least 2 years, not an engineer aspiring to grow into the title.

You will set the architectural direction for our Salesforce platform, conduct code reviews, lead architecture and design sessions, build and maintain the technical backlog, proactively identify gaps in systems and processes, and independently drive solutions to completion.

You will also be a hands-on builder: configuring, coding, and deploying complex solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and our ongoing migration from CPQ to Revenue Cloud.

You will drive our Agentforce and AI strategy, own integrations with critical systems like Ironclad, Intacct, and the broader GTM toolchain, and play a lead role in ongoing security hardening of the Salesforce org.
Your work will directly support strategic company-wide initiatives, improve customer experience, and increase productivity for internal users across GTM, support, and compliance functions.
We work Flexible First . This role can be performed remotely in the United States, only in one of our National locations, which you can review here .

Own end-to-end Salesforce architecture across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Revenue Cloud (including our active CPQ → Revenue Cloud migration)
Lead architecture and design sessions, producing clear design documents, solution options, and tradeoff analyses
Author and maintain coding and design standards for SFDC and ecosystem applications.
Conduct thorough code reviews and enforce engineering best practices, security standards, and declarative-first design principles
Build and maintain the technical backlog—translating platform observations, stakeholder needs, and audit findings into well-scoped engineering work
Proactively identify gaps in system design, data integrity, automation, and integrations; propose and deliver solutions before they become incidents
Conduct regular Org Health Assessments and define a continuous improvement roadmap for platform quality, security, and performance
Own Salesforce release management pipeline, sandbox strategy, source code control, CI/CD tooling and assessment ensuring clean, auditable deployments
Development & Delivery
Design, build, test, and deploy solutions in an Agile framework using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, REST/SOAP APIs, and platform events
Lead the technical design and implementation of Agentforce and AI-powered automation across GTM, customer support, and compliance workflows
Design and build integrations with internal and external systems, including Ironclad (CLM), Snowflake, and other GTM/RevOps tooling
Define testing strategy, write test scripts, and execute tests to meet quality and coverage standards across releases
Maintain high sprint velocity while upholding code quality and documentation standards

Own hands-on remediation of Salesforce security findings across the full spectrum, session/certificate hardening, sharing model and default access control fixes, data exposure and classification gaps, public link/OAuth and connected app governance, and secure-coding fixes (SOQL injection, XSS, hardcoded credentials, sharing violations) surfaced by code scans
Leverage Salesforce Shield Event Monitoring to capture and analyze login, API, and transaction logs moving from passive log collection to proactive threat detection, anomaly alerts, and audit-ready reporting
Design for appropriate data classification, access controls, and auditability across compliance-critical Salesforce objects

Implement and maintain the org's backup and recovery solution including configuring backup schedules, monitoring job health, and running restore/recovery procedures when needed

Translate complex business requirements from GTM, LRC, and Product Support into well-architected, scalable Salesforce solutions
Communicate technical tradeoffs and architecture decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Lead stakeholder demos and participate in Agile ceremonies including standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives

About MongoDB
MongoDB는 변화를 위해 만들어졌습니다. 우리는 고객과 구성원들이 시장의 속도에 맞춰 혁신할 수 있도록 지원합니다. 우리는 AI 시대를 위한 데이터 플랫폼을 새롭게 정의함으로써, 빌더들이 소프트웨어를 통해 산업을 창조하고, 변화시키며, 혁신할 수 있도록 돕고 있습니다. 시장에서 가장 폭넓게 제공되며 전 세계에 분산된 MongoDB의 통합 데이터 플랫폼은 조직이 레거시 워크로드를 현대화하고, 혁신을 수용하며, AI의 잠재력을 최대한 발휘할 수 있도록 지원합니다. 클라우드 네이티브 플랫폼인 MongoDB Atlas는 전 세계에 분산된 유일한 멀티클라우드 데이터 플랫폼으로, AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure 전반에서 사용할 수 있습니다.
전 세계에 오피스를 두고 있는 MongoDB는 67,000개 이상의 고객을 보유하고 있으며, 여기에는 포춘 100대 기업의 75%와 AI 네이티브 스타트업이 포함됩니다. 이들은 가장 중요한 애플리케이션을 MongoDB로 운영하고 있으며, 우리는 소프트웨어의 다음 시대를 이끌고 있습니다.
MongoDB에서 우리의 나침반은 Leadership Commitment 입니다. 이는 우리가 어떻게, 그리고 왜 의사결정을 내리는지, 서로를 위해 어떻게 행동하는지, 그리고 어떻게 함께 성공하는지를 이끄는 기준입니다. 이것이 바로 MongoDB를 MongoDB답게 만드는 요소입니다.
우리는 모든 구성원의 개인적 성장과 비즈니스 영향력을 높이기 위해, 모든 사람에게 지지와 풍요로움을 제공하는 문화를 만드는 데 헌신하고 있습니다. 직원 커뮤니티(affinity groups)에서부터 난임 치료 지원, 그리고 넉넉한 부모 휴가 제도 에 이르기까지, 우리는 구성원의 웰빙을 중요하게 여기며, 그들의 직업적·개인적 여정을 모든 단계에서 지원합니다. MongoDB에서 일하는 것이 어떤 경험인지 더 알아보고, 세상에 변화를 만드는 우리의 여정에 함께해 주세요!

**Experis** recrute un **Architecte IT Manufacturing 4.0** pour concevoir et déployer des solutions IT manufacturières évolutives pour des environnements industriels internationaux.
Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez l'architecture et l'intégration des systèmes clés incluant **ERP, MES, WMS et plateformes de données industrielles**, assurant une connectivité fluide entre les environnements métier et production.
### **Responsabilités clés** ###
* Concevoir des architectures IT de bout en bout pour les sites de production.
* Définir les stratégies d'intégration entre ERP, MES, WMS, automatisation et systèmes de données.
* Diriger des ateliers clients et recueillir les exigences métier et techniques.
* Agir en tant que conseiller de confiance pour les clients et parties prenantes tout au long des cycles de projet.

* Soutenir les activités de déploiement, validation, tests et mise en production.
### **Votre profil** ###
* Licence ou Master en informatique, ingénierie ou domaine connexe.
* Minimum **5 ans d'expérience** en architecture de solutions dans les environnements manufacturiers, industriels ou réglementés.
* Expertise avérée en **intégration ERP/MES** et architecture des systèmes de production.
* Solide expérience en relation client, avec la capacité de traduire les besoins métier en solutions techniques robustes.
* Excellentes compétences en communication, leadership et gestion des parties prenantes.
* Anglais courant (C1+); le français, l'allemand ou toute autre langue est un plus.
### **Exigences de déplacement** ###
Ce poste requiert **20-30% de déplacements internationaux**. La flexibilité est essentielle, car les projets impliquent régulièrement des visites sur sites clients et de production à travers le monde. Lors des phases clés de déploiement, les candidats doivent être prêts à passer **plusieurs semaines consécutives sur site à l'étranger** pour soutenir l'intégration, les tests et la mise en production.
## **Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?** ##
* Rôle stratégique en architecture avec visibilité mondiale.
* Opportunité de façonner les paysages IT manufacturiers et les initiatives de transformation digitale.
* Forte exposition à l'intégration ERP/MES et aux projets de digitalisation industrielle.
* Environnement international avec interaction directe avec clients et décideurs.
* Opportunité de carrière à long terme dans un secteur en croissance et innovant.

The Pre-Sales Solutions Architect (SA) Leader owns the health, direction, and performance of the Solutions Architecture function. Where an individual SA is the technical owner within the sales cycle for their assigned opportunities, the SA Leader is accountable for technical win rate and deal velocity across the entire pre-sales motion — every channel the team supports, and the people who deliver against it.
The SA Leader is a player-coach: they carry direct accountability for channel coverage, the most strategic or highest-stakes evaluations, and cross-functional GTM alignment, while spending the majority of their time developing individual SAs so the team's proactive, commercially-sharp approach scales without becoming order-taking.
Compensation Note: SA Leader compensation is tied to team-wide ARR bookings — new logo, expansion, and multi-year commitments across every SA's pipeline, not just deals the Leader personally works. The Leader is expected to operate with the same commercial mindset as the team, at portfolio scale.

People Leadership & Team Development
The SA Leader hires, coaches, and grows the SA team so each member operates as a credible, commercially sharp technical partner in the sales cycle. This includes:
Hiring and onboarding new SAs, including calibrating them against the channel-specific technical evaluation prompts
Running regular 1:1s, reviewing deal strategy, PoC scoping, and objection handling, and giving direct feedback
Building and maintaining repeatable playbooks (discovery frameworks, PoC templates, objection/RFP responses, competitive positioning) so quality doesn't depend on tenure
Setting and holding the team to a consistent bar for technical depth, commercial instinct, and quota attainment
Channel & Coverage Ownership
The SA Leader owns the coverage model for the entire function — deciding, tracking, and rebalancing which SAs support which channels, and closing gaps as pipeline shifts. This includes accountability across all five channels in the SA Channel Mapping :
Direct Sales (AMER, EMEA, APJ)
Hyperscalers (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI)
Accelerators, Incubators, VCs (YCombinator, TechStars, 500 Startups)
SfP + OAuth Partners (Lovable, Bolt, Anthropic)
Solution Providers ( Postgres.ai , Stormatics)
Rebalancing SA assignment across channels as pipeline volume, deal complexity, or new partner motions shift
Resolving coverage gaps (a channel with no dedicated SA depth, or a region outgrowing its current allocation) and deciding when a hire, a cross-channel reassignment, or a controlled exception is the right fix
Approving which opportunities warrant Leader-level involvement directly, versus staying with the assigned SA
Technical Sales Ownership (oversight)
The SA Leader ensures every significant opportunity has a clear, accountable technical owner across architecture fit, use cases, evaluation criteria, and competitive positioning — spot-checking deal documentation and risk tracking across the pipeline, and stepping in directly on the largest or most strategic evaluations.

The SA Leader ensures the team consistently qualifies opportunities as technically winnable early, coaching SAs on discovery quality and holding the team accountable for surfacing deal-level risk to AEs and sales leadership before it costs a deal.
Proof of Concept and Evaluation Support (oversight)
The SA Leader ensures PoCs across the team are scoped to demonstrate differentiated value, not just technical box-checking — auditing success criteria, evaluation structure, and win-rate patterns across the whole book of active evaluations.
Technical Objection Handling (oversight)
The SA Leader is the escalation layer above the individual SA for the hardest architecture, security, or compliance objections — brought in on RFPs, security questionnaires, and competitive deals that could stall without senior technical input, without replacing the SA as the deal's primary technical contact.
Commercial Technical Alignment (oversight)
The SA Leader ensures the team consistently connects technical requirements to commercial outcomes across the pipeline, and personally engages on pricing/packaging justification and expansion-signal strategy for the largest deals.
Internal Collaboration
Sales (Account Executives)
The SA Leader partners with Sales leadership to make sure SA/AE pairing is working at the portfolio level — owning the technical narrative in aggregate while sales leadership owns the commercial motion — and personally steps in when a specific SA/AE partnership needs adjudicating.
Partnerships
The SA Leader works with Partner Leads across every channel (Hyperscalers, Accelerators, SfP+OAuth, Solution Providers) to make sure SA support scales with each channel's motion, while commercial terms and channel strategy stay owned by the Partner Lead.
Engineering and Product
The SA Leader represents the aggregated market signal — patterns across deals, not just one opportunity — to engineering and product, and prioritizes which recurring technical blockers or roadmap gaps are costing the team deals versus which are one-offs.
Technical Account Management (TAM) and Customer Engineering
The SA Leader ensures handoff quality from pre-sale to post-sale is consistent across the team — auditing that architecture decisions, commitments, and open items are documented well enough that TAMs and CEs can drive early adoption without re-discovering the deal.
Success Metrics
SA Leader effectiveness is measured by commercial and technical outcomes across the whole team, not just their own deals:
Team ARR Bookings — new logo and expansion ARR across every SA's pipeline, relative to team quota
Deal Velocity — time from technical qualification to technical win, tracked across channels
PoC Win Rate — percentage of structured evaluations that convert to closed-won, team-wide
Pipeline Coverage — volume and quality of SA-engaged opportunities relative to quota, per channel
Handoff Quality — post-sale team satisfaction with documentation and deal context, across the team
Team health — ramp time to productivity for new SAs, retention of the SA team itself

The Senior Director, Platform Architecture owns the end-to-end technical architecture for the Agentic Service Catalog. You are responsible for ensuring that the platform operates as one secure, scalable, governable, and maintainable system even though its capabilities, data, workflows, integrations, and AI services are supplied by many teams.
You will define the contracts that make the federated model work: APIs, workflows, events, schemas, integration boundaries, identity, policy, approvals, evidence, observability, versioning, compatibility, and ownership boundaries.
This is a hands-on engaged manager architecture role, not an architecture-review-only position. You will develop APIs and AI capabilities, build reference implementations, review critical code, solve complex integration problems, and coordinate technical direction across the teams contributing to the Service Catalog.
This job reports to the Vice President Intelligent Automation and Data Platforms
Target-State Architecture
Manage and evolve the target-state architecture for the Agentic Service Catalog and its supporting workflow, control, and knowledge capabilities.
Establish how the platform integrates with service management, source control, CI/CD, cloud, observability, security, network, data platforms, identity, and other enterprise systems.
Ensure enterprise systems remain while the Service Catalog assembles usable context and governed workflows around them.
API, Workflow, Event & Data Contracts
You will define standards for APIs, events, workflow interfaces, schemas, errors, idempotency, retries, compensation, observability, versioning, and compatibility.
You will establish the technical contract for every reusable capability contributed to the Service Catalog.
Design stable interfaces that allow domain-owned capabilities to evolve without breaking user journeys or long-running workflows.
Ensure critical interfaces are typed, versioned, testable, observable, and connected to a named owner and support model.
Governance & Control-Plane Architecture
Design runtime policy gates for sensitive and production-affecting activities and ensure side effects occur only through governed execution paths.
Ensure actions are attributable to an authenticated principal, registered capability, policy decision, approval state, execution record, and evidence package.

Unlock the potential of vector search: Implement powerful vector search algorithms and create high-dimensional vector representations of data, allowing users to find the information they need even with imprecise queries.
Deliver compelling proof-of-concept (POC) projects: Showcase the combined value of AI, semantic search, vector search, and ELSER through successful POCs, demonstrating the potential for improved search relevance, user experience, and decision-making.
Become a thought leader and evangelize our vision: Share your expertise through presentations, blog posts, and other channels, positioning Elastic as the leader in AI-powered search and semantic data exploration.
Cultivate a collaborative environment within the Solutions Architecture team and across departments, promoting knowledge sharing and driving continuous improvement.
Collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, data scientists, and industry experts who are passionate about pushing the boundaries of search and AI-powered solutions.
Continuously learn and explore the ever-evolving landscapes of AI, semantic search, vector search, and related technologies, ensuring your solutions are always at the forefront of innovation. We provide access to world-class training programs and cutting-edge technology.

Deep understanding of AI and semantic search technologies, with a focus on RAG, vector search, and NLP.

Solid knowledge of ELSER's architecture and other models within the Hugging Face ecosystem.

Excellent communication and presentation skills, able to engage both technical and non-technical audiences. We think of it like this, “ You may be speaking to a developer in the morning, an architect in the afternoon and an executive buyer in the evening.”

Range in one conversation. You can go from banter to a rigorous design discussion, and both feel natural.

Provectus is a Premier AWS partner and an Anthropic Strategic Partner at the forefront of applied AI, helping enterprises turn Claude, agentic systems, and their own data into measurable business outcomes through bespoke applications, managed services, and advisory engagements. With offices in North America, LATAM, and EMEA, we partner with clients worldwide and are obsessed with reimagining how they operate and compete.
Our work centers on two verticals — Financial Services & Insurance and Healthcare & Life Sciences — where we deploy five pre-built AI Blueprints: Submission Flow, Portfolio Lens, Asset Flow, Revenue Flow, and Evidence Lens. Each Blueprint rebuilds a critical business process front to back, shipped from working code and tuned to a client's specific book, regulators, and operating posture.
We embed engineers and leaders inside client operations as Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) and Forward Deployed Executives (FDX) — people who learn the work, ship the system, and own the outcome. Our team holds 100+ AWS certifications, is Claude Code certified, and co-delivers Anthropic's Agentic SDLC program, Cowork Activation, and AI Bluprints.
You will do the customer’s job before you automate it.
Most AI engagements fail the same way: someone gathers requirements, someone writes a PRD, and a team ships a workflow nobody uses. We think the requirements-gathering step is the bug. So we remove it.
A Forward Deployed AI Engineer at Provectus spends the first weeks of an engagement in the operator’s seat — as the underwriter, the analyst, the RCM specialist, the claims clinician, whoever actually does the work we’ve been asked to change. You do the job. You learn the constraints from the inside, the ones nobody writes down. Then you sit at a table with that operator and a Forward Deployed Executive and rebuild the function from first principles — and you are the one who builds it.

s.h: Three things define how you work
s.t:
Embedded, not engaged . You are part of the customer’s team and inside their process — not a vendor running a project alongside it.
Real tasks, not scope . You are not fenced into a siloed deliverable. You go where the operating problem is.
Autonomous . Embedded is not staff-augmented. You own the method; nobody hands you a ticket.
You won’t start from zero. Provectus builds industry blueprints — working systems that have already shipped for a customer in your industry. Your engagement starts from that baseline, and what you learn in the field goes back into it. That loop is the difference between an outcome and an invoice.
You’ll be measured on whether the Business Unit’s number moved — not on hours, not on scope delivered.
This is a role for engineers who have led before — as a founder, a CTO, a staff engineer — and who want to stay in the code while owning the outcome. On most days you’ll be the most senior technical person in the room, and you’ll still be the one shipping.

8+ years building software , a substantial share of it writing production code you were accountable for. You are hands-on today and intend to stay that way.
You will take the operator’s seat. You are genuinely willing to spend weeks doing someone else’s job — claims processing, underwriting, revenue-cycle work — before you write a line of code. Engineers who need to stay in the IDE should not apply.
You learn domains fast. Demonstrated ability to become conversant in an unfamiliar business function quickly enough to argue with the people who do it for a living.
Shipped GenAI/LLM systems to production — not demos, not notebooks. You’ve handled the parts that get hard after the prototype works.
You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a non-deterministic system, and you can explain what you measured and why.
Strong engineering fundamentals — dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or language, you’re productive. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack.
Cloud-native delivery on AWS (GCP/Azure a plus): containers, Kubernetes/ECS, IaC, CI/CD, and the operational reality of a system someone else inherits.
Credible with senior stakeholders — you can hold a redesign conversation with a BU head and a scoping conversation with a CTO without losing either room.
Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. Engagements start underspecified by design. Closing that gap is the job.
Solid AI/ML foundations — you understand what the models do well enough to reason about failure modes, not just call the API.
Strong hands-on prodcution experience with Claude Code/Cowork.
Fluent English, written and spoken.

Prior experience as a founder, CTO, or engineering leader who has chosen to return to individual contribution.
Real depth in one of our blueprint industries: financial services, insurance, healthcare, asset management .
Consulting, professional services, or other embedded customer-facing delivery.
Data platform depth: data lakes, warehouses, streaming and real-time analytics, data mesh and data contracts, governance and data quality.
MLOps and classical ML: PyTorch, SageMaker, MLflow.
Fine-tuning, distillation, or inference/serving optimization.
Graph databases (Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
IaC depth: AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform.
Open-source contributions or public writing on applied AI.

Take the seat
Do the operator’s job for two to four weeks at the start of an engagement. Learn the function from inside, not from a requirements doc.
Reach working fluency in a new domain — insurance underwriting, healthcare revenue cycle, asset flow — in weeks, not quarters.
Sit with the operator and the Forward Deployed Executive and redesign the function from first principles. Discovery, user research, and PRD-writing collapse into one team that re-imagines its own job. You are all three roles.
Build
Ship production GenAI systems into the customer’s environment — LLM applications, agentic workflows, retrieval and structured-extraction pipelines, and the services around them. Running software, not recommendations.
Build the evaluation harness before you build the feature. When the engagement is bound to a business KPI, “it looked good in testing” is not an answer. Define what working means, instrument it, and let the evals drive the design.
Write production code across the stack — backend services, data pipelines, and the AI layer. Python and TypeScript are our centre of gravity; we choose tools to fit the customer, not the résumé.
Take systems to production on AWS (GCP/Azure where the customer requires it): containerized, observable, and maintainable after we leave.
Start from the blueprint, and feed the blueprint. What you learn in the field becomes the baseline the next engagement starts from.
Own the outcome
Work in a pair with a Forward Deployed Executive who carries the Business Unit’s KPIs. Your work is measured against the same number.
Drive adoption. A system the BU routes around has not shipped. Change management is part of the engineering job here, not a phase after it.
Be credible with the customer’s engineers, their operators, and their executives — and be willing to disagree with all three.

Govern secure use of mobile keystores and secure enclaves, including iOS Secure Enclave and Android Hardware Keystore.

Define integration with enterprise key vaults and HSMs for signing, encryption, certificate handling, and key lifecycle management.
Own OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, PKCE, secure token storage, token rotation, and device-bound session models for mobile and web channels.
Define API, Backend-for-Frontend, and service security patterns aligned to Zero Trust principles.
Lead threat modelling across onboarding, authentication, payments, card management, account servicing, and other sensitive customer journeys.
Translate threats into architecture patterns, security controls, non-functional requirements, and architecture decision records.
Embed Security-by-Design into HLDs, LLDs, architecture decision records, release governance, and delivery assurance forums.

Support penetration testing, vulnerability remediation, incident readiness, forensic readiness, and cyber-resilience initiatives.
Embed Privacy-by-Design, consent management, secure data processing, secure data retention, and data lifecycle controls.

Balance security, customer experience, operational resilience, and delivery velocity.
Ensure the mobile banking platform meets world-class standards for security, trust, resilience, and regulatory compliance.

Architect device binding and trusted device frameworks using hardware-backed cryptographic identities, secure key stores, and device attestation services.
Define transaction signing and transaction verification patterns to support non-repudiation and customer protection for high-risk banking transactions.
Govern certificate pinning, mutual TLS, secure channel enforcement, and secure API communication models.
Define runtime application self-protection and mobile application shielding strategies to detect and prevent tampering, reverse engineering, instrumentation, rooting, and jailbreak attacks.
Architect controls against mobile malware, overlays, screen scraping, session hijacking, credential theft, and application manipulation.

Define secure customer onboarding patterns using device reputation, identity verification, fraud signals, behavioural analytics, and risk-based authentication.

Govern security logging, auditability, evidentiary controls, and forensic readiness for regulatory investigations and major incident response.
Assess and govern third-party, fintech, SaaS, martech, payment, and partner integrations from a security architecture perspective.
